violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED TURKEY AT 47F IN TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP; RAW CHICKEN AT 46F IN SPARTAN 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD SLICED TURKEY AND TRANSFER RAW CHICKEN TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: TUNA SALAD DATED 05/22/2025 IN BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOOD DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SOUR CREAM AT 48F, MILK AT 48F, PORTIONED SALSA AT 45F AND SOUR CREAM AT 45F IN TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT, CUT TOMATOES AT 45F, SLICED HAM AT 47F, SLICED TURKEY AT 48F IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED SOUR CREAM AND MILK FROM TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT. ALL OTHER TCS FOODS WERE TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required for ROP
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in ROP OF CORN BEEF DATED 03/24; WILD BOAR DATED 8/31; VEAL DATED 12/24.
violations.corrective_action: SUBMIT HACCP PLAN FOR ROP FOODS TO BE HELD FOR MORE THAN 48 HOURS. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD ALL ROP FOODS PREPARED IN HOUSE AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 48 HOURS. FACILITY IS ALLOWED TO ROP MEATS WHICH MUST BE USED WITHIN 48 HOURS OF PACKAGING WITHOUT A HACCP PLAN.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP (GRILL) AND 2 DOOR PREP TOP (SALAD STATION).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL UNITS ARE EQUIPPED WITH FUNCTIONAL THERMOMETERS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT AT 42-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC REMOVED TCS FOODS COOLING AND DISCARDED FOOD STORED FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS. DO NOT USE UNIT TO STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.
